noAnchorGaps.concept: Zone flip back to positive as buyers retake control, and zone flips lining up with momentum shifts on the price chart
noAnchorGaps.quote: Then it flips back positive as buyers retake control. Those zone flips often line up with momentum shifts on the price chart.
noAnchorGaps.why: move fsvzo exposes only buyZone and sellZone as point anchors, both already labelled by the existing show; there is no distinct anchor for the flip event itself or for any price-chart momentum-shift alignment point, so nothing can be drawn without inventing an anchor

notes: Only one CHART beat ('chart', move fsvzo); the other three beats (intro, use, recap) are CONCEPT and draw nothing. The accumulated show already marks both of the move's two anchors: marker at buyZone ('buying-volume zone', reversal, above) covers 'positive buying zone', and marker at sellZone ('selling-volume zone', sweep, below) covers 'negative selling zone'. Both labels and place choices match the say. The remaining say references (the flip back to positive, and the momentum-shift alignment on price) have no corresponding fsvzo anchor and are correctly recorded as a noAnchorGap.
